about.text: A cacioricotta from the Cilento in Campania, said to be made from goat's milk, eaten fresh or aged for 3 to 4 months. The milk is heated and started with acid whey from the day before, set with kid rennet, and the curd is pressed in traditional moulds; the wheels are dried and dry-salted by hand.
